title: Measure overhead and qualify execution budgets
summary: Measure whether semantic assessment preserves the intended lightweight experience using explicit workload denominators and budget enforcement. Record total overhead, waiting and repeated work; provider latency alone cannot demonstrate that the substrate is inexpensive or unobtrusive.
in_scope: Declared profile budgets, percentiles and baseline comparison
out_of_scope: Inventing a numerical low-overhead target from an unspecified note
Reporting unknown usage as zero or free
implementation: Define counters for logical requests, actual attempts, cache hits, question/packet bytes, usage and costs with a versioned price basis or unknown reason.
Instrument CPU, queue waiting, provider time, blocking time and wall time; report p50/p95 only with sample counts and measurement mode.
Compare A and B under the same frozen workload and state explicit denominators for percentage overhead, including zero-baseline handling.
Enforce declared per-run, per-matter and per-investigation budgets before dispatch and at retry/follow-up boundaries.
Exercise bursts, duplicate events, rate-limit retries and unhelpful investigation to expose repeated-cost paths while retaining unresolved outcomes when limits stop work.

acceptance.criterion: Actual retries and speculative questions appear in total cost and workload counts.
acceptance.verification: Use controlled retries and batched fixtures and reconcile counters with receipts.

acceptance.criterion: Exhausted budgets prevent additional dispatch without marking the matter resolved.
acceptance.verification: Run a bounded request burst and assert call limits, explicit incomplete status and preserved evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Unavailable usage or zero baseline time cannot generate a misleading zero-cost or percentage claim.
acceptance.verification: Test missing metadata and zero-duration baseline fixtures and inspect report nulls and reasons.

tests: A cache hit avoids a new call but still incurs local processing.
Repeated failures consume attempts until the declared cap.
Concurrent queue delay is measured separately from provider latency.
risks: Price tables and SDK usage fields can drift independently of model behavior.

reuse.application: Adapt observable byte/usage/timing fields while preserving unknown measurements.
